# Introduction

This report assesses whether a study is feasible in patients who have pharmacy coverage, at least two endometriosis claims, and NSAID use as a treatment. Candidates come from `candidates.csv`. Subgroups are defined by the combinations of age band and region, and a subgroup is considered large enough if it has at least 30 patients.

The cohort definition assumes that `n_index_claims` counts endometriosis claims.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(bslib)
library(bsicons)
library(reactable)

source("helpers.R")
candidates <- read.csv("candidates.csv")
```

# Cohort definition

Patients are kept if they have pharmacy coverage (`rx_coverage == "Y"`), at least two endometriosis claims (`n_index_claims >= 2`), and NSAID use (`tx_nsaid`).

```{r}
#| label: filter-cohort
cohort <- candidates |>
  filter(rx_coverage == "Y", n_index_claims >= 2, tx_nsaid)

subgroup_counts <- count_subgroup_cells(cohort, "age_band", "region")
```

Of `{r} format(nrow(candidates), big.mark = ",")` candidates, `{r} format(nrow(cohort), big.mark = ",")` meet the criteria.

# Subgroup feasibility

```{r}
#| label: value-boxes
layout_column_wrap(
  width = "220px",
  cohort_value_box(cohort, title = "Candidates meeting criteria"),
  subgroups_value_box(cohort, "age_band", "region"),
  smallest_subgroup_value_box(cohort, "age_band", "region")
)
```

# Patient counts by subgroup

```{r}
#| label: subgroup-heatmap
subgroup_heatmap(cohort, "age_band", "region")
```

# Observations

`{r} sum(subgroup_counts$meets_min)` of `{r} nrow(subgroup_counts)` subgroups have at least 30 patients. The smallest subgroup has `{r} min(subgroup_counts$n)` patients.

The subgroups below 30 patients are:

```{r}
#| label: small-subgroups
subgroup_counts |>
  filter(!meets_min) |>
  arrange(n)
```

# Matching patients

```{r}
#| label: cohort-table
reactable(cohort, filterable = TRUE, compact = TRUE, wrap = FALSE)
```
